source_refs.note: 'Understanding Causality' under topic 6.9, as printed (PDF 88, printed 84).

blocks.text: Causality explains why an event happens. It shows a cause-and-effect relationship. One factor directly influences another. Causality is important in scientific studies to understand real reasons behind events. Data alone may not show causality but experiments often identify causes. Causal understanding improves decisions and avoids false assumptions.
